items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: We were both with Bora Menovic harmonica band in 1928.

ctx.x: I didn't know that. That somehow slipped my attention.

My brother Johnny was also born in Oakland, Mississippi. Just exactly what year. I think it was 1903. My oldest brother Tom was born in 1900. Then the next oldest brother, Dick, his name was Richard, was in 1929, acclaimed the world's greatest harmonica player in Berlin, Germany, at the Hohner harmonica factory. He had the honor of playing in the presence of President von Hindenburg in Germany in that contest. And he won that acclaim. We were both with Bora Menovic harmonica band in 1928. And we were with Helen…
